name: reference_mask_combined_v21
method: Reasoning-driven direct weight-space programming without training
hypothesis: The v15 combination improves all four aggregate pilot metrics but retains R/S errors in three systems and an E/Z error in one. Add the same-reference mask intervention to test whether local reference-space information helps preserve the stronger coordinate and bond-order signals. Keep this distinct from the mask-only ablation so any interaction can be identified.
